1. This Act may be cited as the Asian Development Bank
Act, 1966.

2. In this Act unless the context otherwise requires—

"agreement" means the international agreement for the
establishment and operation of the Asian Development
Bank signed at Manila, Philippines on the 4th of December,
1965;

"Article" means Article of! the agreement;

"Bank" means the Asian Development Bank established
by the agreement;

"Minister" means the Minister of Finance.
